evidence.quote: The funding comprises $26 million in equity led by Accel, with participation from Prosus Ventures, BeeGlobal, Bajaj Finance’s Finserv Intelligence and Bajaj Alts AI Opportunities Fund, Dallas Venture Capital, Lighthouse Canton, and Jump Trading. It also includes $21 million in venture debt led by Lighthouse Canton, with participation from Trifecta Capital.

title: India’s Humyn Labs raises $47M to feed U.S. robotics companies the data they need
displayTitle: Humyn Labs完成4700万美元融资，股权与债务各占一部分
summary: TechCrunch报道，印度机器人训练数据公司Humyn Labs获得4700万美元A轮融资，其中2600万美元为Accel领投的股权融资，另有2100万美元风险债务。公司采集并标注真人活动数据，服务机器人和世界模型开发；两类资本成本不同，不能把总额直接当作股权估值的依据。
